name: hound-jump
description: Counterplay run for the houndframe trial (?hound=1): identical to hound-grounded.json — same URL, same enemies, same 2.4s window, same terrain jump at the x=39 step — plus ONE jump at 1330ms, inside the first hound's telegraph and before it commits. Whichever way the approach resolves, that press is a movement answer: from the deck it is a jump over the charge, and from the chimney face it is a wall-launch away from it. Everything else is held constant, so the hit-count difference isolates the hound's charge.
